tasks.gr9-lithosphere-earth-resources-t4: Topic: Lithosphere and Earth Resources. Cover rocks, minerals, Earth structure, plate tectonics, mining, fossil fuels, and renewable resources. Ask learners to classify rock types, explain plate movement, evaluate mining impacts, or compare renewable and non-renewable resources.
tasks.gr9-stars-universe-t4: Topic: Stars and the Universe. Cover stars as fusion reactors, star life cycles (nebula to death), galaxies, the Milky Way, and the scale of the universe. Ask learners to sequence star life stages, explain nuclear fusion, describe galaxy organisation, or interpret the vast distances in space.
